grades.quote: After executing the `IDLE` instruction, the processor core will stop fetching instructions and enter the wait state until it is woken up by an interrupt or is reset. After waking up from the wait state by an interrupt, the first instruction executed by the processor core is the one after `IDLE` .
grades.reason: Directly states the suspension behavior and guarantees resumption at the following instruction after interrupt wakeup.
